blank: FIELD-OPT.description: If True, the field is allowed to be blank.

null: FIELD-OPT (True).description: If True, Django will store empty values as NULL in the database.

null: FIELD-OPT (False).description: If True, Django will store empty values as NULL in the database.

choices: FIELD-OPT.description: A mapping or iterable to use as choices for this field.

db_column: FIELD-OPT.description: The name of the database column to use for this field.

db_comment: FIELD-OPT.description: The comment on the database column to use for this field.

db_default: FIELD-OPT.description: The database-computed default value for this field.

db_index: FIELD-OPT.description: If True, a database index will be created for this field.

db_tablespace: FIELD-OPT.description: The name of the database tablespace to use for this field's index.

default: FIELD-OPT.description: The default value for the field. This can be a value or a callable object.

editable: FIELD-OPT.description: If False, the field will not be displayed in the admin or any other ModelForm.

error_messages: FIELD-OPT.description: Override the default messages that the field will raise.

help_text: FIELD-OPT.description: Extra 'help' text to be displayed with the form widget.

primary_key: FIELD-OPT.description: If True, this field is the primary key for the model.

unique: FIELD-OPT.description: If True, this field must be unique throughout the table.

unique_for_date: FIELD-OPT.description: Set to the name of a DateField or DateTimeField to require this field be unique for the value of the date field.

unique_for_month: FIELD-OPT.description: Requires the field to be unique with respect to the month.

unique_for_year: FIELD-OPT.description: Requires the field to be unique with respect to the year.

verbose_name: FIELD-OPT.description: A human-readable name for the field.

validators: FIELD-OPT.description: A list of validators to run for this field.

BigAutoField.description: A 64-bit integer, much like an AutoField.

BinaryField.description: A field to store raw binary data.

CompositePrimaryKey.description: A virtual field used for defining a composite primary key.

CharField.description: A string field, for small- to large-sized strings.

DateField.description: A date, represented in Python by a datetime.date instance.

DateField (auto_now_add).description: A DateField automatically set when the object is first created.

DateField (auto_now).description: A DateField automatically set to now every time the object is saved.

DateTimeField.description: A date and time, represented in Python by a datetime.datetime instance.

DateTimeField (auto_now_add).description: A DateTimeField automatically set when the object is first created.

DateTimeField (auto_now).description: A DateTimeField automatically set to now every time the object is saved.

DurationField.description: A field for storing periods of time.

EmailField.description: A CharField that checks that the value is a valid email address.

body: $1 = models.FilePathField(path="$2", match=${3:None}, recursive=${4|False,True|}, allow_files=${5|True,False|}, allow_folders=${6|False,True|}, max_length=${7:100}, $8)
FilePathField.description: A CharField whose choices are limited to the filenames in a certain directory on the filesystem.

FloatField.description: A floating-point number represented in Python by a float instance.

GeneratedField.description: A field that is always computed based on other fields in the model.

GenericIPAddressField.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, in string format.

ImageField.description: Inherits all attributes and methods from FileField, but also validates that the uploaded object is a valid image.

JSONField.description: A field for storing JSON encoded data.

PositiveBigIntegerField.description: Like a PositiveIntegerField, but only allows values under a certain (database-dependent) point.

PositiveIntegerField.description: Like an IntegerField, but must be either positive or zero.

PositiveSmallIntegerField.description: Like a PositiveIntegerField, but only allows values under a certain point.

SlugField.description: A slug is a short label for something, containing only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.

SmallAutoField.description: Like an AutoField, but only allows values under a certain limit.

SmallIntegerField.description: Like an IntegerField, but only allows values under a certain point.

TimeField.description: A time, represented in Python by a datetime.time instance.

UUIDField.description: A field for storing universally unique identifiers.

abstract: META.description: If abstract = True, this model will be an abstract base class.

app_label: META.description: If a model is defined outside of an application in INSTALLED_APPS, it must declare which app it belongs to.

base_manager_name: META.description: The attribute name of the manager to use for the model's _base_manager.

db_table: META.description: The name of the database table to use for the model.

db_table_comment: META.description: The comment on the database table to use for this model.

db_tablespace: META.description: The name of the database tablespace to use for this model.

default_manager_name: META.description: The name of the manager to use for the model's _default_manager.

default_related_name: META.description: The name that will be used by default for the relation from a related object back to this one.

get_latest_by: META.description: The name of a field or a list of field names in the model, typically DateField, DateTimeField, or IntegerField.

managed: META.description: Defaults to True, meaning Django will create the appropriate database tables in migrate or as part of migrations and remove them as part of a flush management command.

order_with_respect_to: META.description: Makes this object orderable with respect to the given field, usually a ForeignKey.

ordering: META.description: The default ordering for the object, for use when obtaining lists of objects.

permissions: META.description: Extra permissions to enter into the permissions table when creating this object.

proxy: META.description: If proxy = True, a model which subclasses another model will be treated as a proxy model.

required_db_features: META.description: List of database features that the current connection should have so that the model is considered during the migration phase.

required_db_vendor: META.description: Name of a supported database vendor that this model is specific to.

select_on_save: META.description: Determines if Django will use the pre-1.6 django.db.models.Model.save() algorithm.

indexes: META.description: A list of indexes that you want to define on the model.

unique_together: META.description: Sets of field names that, taken together, must be unique.

constraints: META.description: A list of constraints that you want to define on the model.

verbose_name: META.description: A human-readable name for the object, singular.

verbose_name_plural: META.description: The plural name for the object.
